note: Mirrors the gr surface exactly. A test derives this same shape from the compiled clap tree and fails the build on any drift — a skill that names a command or flag the binary does not have is a defect.

output.default: JSON on stdout; the primary consumer is an agent.
output.refusals: Exit 0 with {"refused":{code,suggestion,reason,detail}}. Every refusal names what to do instead. Under --quiet a refusal exits 5, because there is no other channel — never chain `gr <cmd> && …` on a bare exit code without --quiet.

globals.--store: Store to operate on. Defaults to the nearest .graphene/store.db. Env GRAPHENE_STORE.
globals.--session: Session identity for claims and presence. Env GRAPHENE_SESSION.
globals.--human: Render tables for a person instead of JSON.
globals.--quiet: Emit nothing; communicate only through the exit code.

workspace.about: Set a repository up to work through Graphene.

init.about: Install the agent skill into a repository, and create the store
init.use_when: Once per repository, before anything else. Writes .claude/skills/graphene/ and .graphene/store.db.

graphs.about: Create, validate, approve, and derive graphs.

new.about: Create a graph from a task
new.use_when: Starting a plan. Pass the user's task in their own words.

plan.about: Replace a draft's nodes from a `task.v1` document on stdin
plan.use_when: You have drafted a task.v1 document. Replaces a draft graph's nodes.

capabilities.about: The capability set this workspace plans against. Registering is additive; gating is one-way
capabilities.use_when: A node needs a capability Graphene does not ship knowing. Register it once, or gr check refuses the plan with unknown-capability.

check.use_when: After every edit to the plan. Exits 3 on failure, with a fix hint per error.

approve.use_when: The user said go. Carries a checked graph through review to approved.

start.use_when: Immediately after approve. Ordinary nodes become claimable.

cancel.about: Stop a graph. Outstanding work is skipped and claims released
cancel.use_when: The plan is wrong and nothing is worth keeping.

amend.about: Derive a new graph, carrying completed outputs forward
amend.use_when: The shape was wrong but completed work is still good. Carries outputs forward.

clone.about: Instantiate a completed graph as a template
clone.use_when: Running a finished graph again as a template.

list.about: Graphs not yet terminal, most recent first
list.use_when: Finding a graph you did not create in this session.

show.use_when: The whole folded state, for a graph you are about to work on.

export.about: The log as newline-delimited JSON, for git and diffing
export.use_when: Diffing a graph in git, or handing the log to another tool.

nodes.about: Take work, report it, and hand it back.

node.about: Everything about a node. The cold-context entry point for a pasted id
node.use_when: THE COLD-CONTEXT ENTRY POINT. Run this first when the user pastes a gn_ id.

nodes.about: Nodes in a graph, optionally filtered
nodes.use_when: Listing a graph's nodes, optionally by state.

claim.about: Take a node, asserting the beliefs the work will rest on
claim.use_when: Taking a node. Pass --assumes with every belief the work will rest on.

renew.use_when: A node is taking longer than its lease. Prefer checkpoint, which also renews.

release.about: Give a node back without finishing it
release.use_when: You cannot finish what you claimed. Give it back rather than let the lease lapse.

checkpoint.about: Record progress at an edge crossing. Renews the lease
checkpoint.use_when: At every edge crossing inside a long node. Records progress and renews the lease.

done.about: Report a result. Validated against the declared schema; fails closed
done.use_when: Reporting a result. Validated against the declared output schema; fails closed.

fail.use_when: The node cannot complete. --retryable describes the cause, not your appetite.

expand.use_when: A for_each node's collection now exists. Materializes the children.

human.about: Put a question to a person without blocking the graph.

await.about: Put a question to a person. Blocks only this node's dependents
await.use_when: Asking a person. --on-timeout has no default, deliberately. --unblocks says what each answer releases; an answer that names nothing skips its dependents, which is the only thing that makes the gate a gate.

awaiting.use_when: Before telling the user what they owe you.

resolve.use_when: Recording a person's answer. --choice must be one of the declared options.

review.about: Record and resolve the findings the review lenses raise.

findings.use_when: After the review lenses run, and before you present anything. An unresolved finding holds the graph.

finding.about: Apply or reject a finding. A reason is required — an unexplained rejection is indistinguishable from not having read it
finding.use_when: Resolving each finding. --resolution is `applied` or `rejected`; rejecting is legitimate, rejecting silently is not.

beliefs.about: Record facts, and change your mind about them honestly.

believe.use_when: A later decision will rest on this fact. Declare --derives-from and --shared honestly.

retract.about: Stop believing something. Refused on observations — use `contradict`
retract.use_when: A conclusion no longer holds. Refused on observations — use contradict.

contradict.about: Record that evidence contradicts a belief, without deleting it
contradict.use_when: Evidence disagrees with a belief. It stays, and becomes BOTH.

uncontradict.use_when: The disagreement resolved in the belief's favour.

corroborate.about: Raise fidelity. The corroborating belief must come from a distinct source
corroborate.use_when: Another belief, from a different source, confirms this one. --by names that belief, not a source string.

reinstate.about: Bring back something that went OUT
reinstate.use_when: Something that went OUT should be believed again.

supersede.about: Replace a belief with a corrected one. On an observation, only immediately after re-observing
supersede.use_when: A corrected version replaces it. On an observation, --observation-proof is a sentence saying how you re-observed.

nogood.about: Record a set that cannot all be true, so it stops being re-proposed
nogood.use_when: A set that cannot all be true. Two or more members; stops it being re-proposed.

dependents.about: What would fall if this belief went
dependents.use_when: What would fall if this belief went.

stale.about: Mark a source's observations stale after a write
stale.use_when: You wrote to a source. Marks everything read from it, and contests what rests on it.

belief.use_when: The full record of one belief.

why.about: What this rests on, and what falls with it
why.use_when: The derivation of a truth state — what it rests on, and what falls with it.

contested.use_when: Before presenting anything to a person. Run it every time.

history.about: Every event touching an id, in order
history.use_when: Every event touching an id, in order.

sessions.about: Join a graph, see who else is on it, and receive push.

attach.about: Join a graph. Starts the server if none is running
attach.use_when: Joining a graph. Starts the server if none is running.

sessions.about: Who is attached, and what they hold
sessions.use_when: Who else is on this graph, and what they hold.

status.about: Where the graph is, and what to do next
status.use_when: Constantly. It returns next_action; do what it says.

wait.about: Block until something relevant happens. How push reaches an agent
wait.use_when: You have nothing runnable but the graph is not finished. Blocks until something happens.

integrity.about: Re-derive, replay, and prove the store.

validate.about: Run every gate. Exits 3 on failure
validate.use_when: Proving the store. Runs every gate; exits 3 on failure.

bench.about: Score the belief layer against the MnemeBrain belief benchmark
bench.use_when: Checking the belief layer against an external benchmark. Writes bench/score.json; the number is only meaningful because the harness is committed.

rebuild.about: Discard every cache and re-derive from the log
rebuild.use_when: Discarding every cache and re-deriving from the log.

fold.about: State at a point in time — what we believed when a node ran
fold.use_when: What we believed at a point in time — the state a node actually ran against.

compact.about: Collapse records that provably cannot change the fold. Self-verifying
compact.use_when: Collapsing records that provably cannot change the fold. Self-verifying.

evidence.about: What the accumulated graphs say about the guidance (spec 09 §7)
evidence.use_when: Reviewing whether the decomposition advice is working: gates nobody declines, capabilities that fail most, plans that keep needing amendment.

serve.about: Run the server in the foreground. `attach` starts it normally
serve.use_when: Running the server in the foreground. attach starts it normally.

ui.about: Open the browser at the running server
ui.use_when: Opening the browser at the running server.
